nodes.speaker: Edmund
nodes.text: I've set the type on every Ripper story we've run. I know the details better than most constables.

nodes.speaker: Edmund
nodes.text: Clara's body was positioned facing west. The Ripper's victims are always found facing east — toward the light, the papers said. We never printed that detail.

nodes.speaker: Edmund
nodes.text: Whoever did this knew the Ripper's method. But they didn't know that one thing. Because it was never published.
nodes.journal_entry: The body was positioned wrong. The killer knew the Ripper's pattern but missed one unpublished detail. Someone who reads our copy — but not someone who has seen the actual crime scenes.
